title: Horthy Miklós és a kormányzóság (The Regency & the Kingdom without a King)
grammar: Institutional Participles (-andó/-endő), Instrumentality Connectors & Historical Discourse

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say who led Hungary after 1920 and what a kingdom without a king was.
I can use -andó / -endő for a task that must be done.
I can say who Horthy was and what the office of Regent was.
I can use six words about the Regency, such as kormányzó and trónfosztás.
